I am planting maize on this half-hectare plot I rented near our compound. I will buy one small bag of government fertilizer from the market because maize cannot grow well on this land without some help, but I cannot afford improved seed or chemicals on top of that. My children and I will do all the work ourselves—clearing, planting, weeding twice, and harvesting—because paying laborers is too expensive for a rented plot this size. We depend only on the rains; there is no water source close enough for irrigation.
